title: driver-sql: schema sync adds a new storage.notNull field to an existing table as NOT NULL with no default — on SQLite the whole object's sync fails and the object becomes unwritable
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAmQQaqVXpJepCqm4Xa

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (found by the hotcrm lane on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2746, PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2787)
Grade: area:data · Bug · p2 (an author adding a required-with-column-constraint field to an existing object loses writes to the whole object on upgrade; the hotcrm card avoided it by dropping `storage.notNull`, so nothing is blocked) · reach: measured on a dev boot, @objectstack 18.6.0, SQLite · evidence measured.
Reader: the `domain:data` seat.
Dedupe: searched `"Cannot add a NOT NULL column"` (1: #23847, closed, Turso remote face never emits NOT NULL — the opposite case), `"schema sync add NOT NULL column existing table"` (0), `"tighten_not_null"` (13, all closed, Turso/migrate-apply or ownership ceremony). None covers the local SQL add-column path.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：给已有对象新增一个带列约束（`storage.notNull`）的必填字段后升级，不再导致整个对象同步失败、无法写入；列先按可空加上，提示需要先回填再收紧。
- 为什么做：今天这样升级会让该对象整体不可写，而字段说明里承诺的是「先回填、经 schema-drift 流程收紧」。
- 出错会怎样：修复只影响加列这一步；修错的话可能漏掉收紧提示，数据不会坏。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What happens

HotCRM added `crm_contract.name` (`Field.text`, `required: true`). Booting it with `storage: { notNull: true }` against a database created before the field existed:

```
alter table crm_contract add column name text not null - Cannot add a NOT NULL column with default value NULL
```

The contract object's whole schema sync fails and contracts become unwritable — on SQLite this happens even with zero rows, because SQLite refuses `ADD COLUMN … NOT NULL` without a default.

## Expected

As the `storage.notNull` describe promises ("a destructive migration gated by the schema-drift ceremony (backfill first)"): schema sync adds the new column nullable, reports `tighten_not_null` drift, and the tightening runs through the ceremony after a backfill. `required` keeps refusing nameless writes meanwhile.

## Done when

Adding a `storage.notNull` field to an object with an existing table boots cleanly on SQLite (and Postgres), the column exists nullable, drift reports `tighten_not_null` for it, and the object stays writable. A test pins it.

Related: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2746 (would declare `storage.notNull` on `crm_contract.name` once this lands and installs have run its backfill).
